owns.rule: Tickets owns canonical SR identity, accepted ticket fields, lifecycle projection, SR↔RFC links, Device Reference context and Working Notes.
Tickets owns canonical RFC identity, accepted status/customer/hierarchy projection, local archival state and reviewed relationship corrections.
Tickets is the sole authority for the exact two-level RFC parent/child relationship and all Master/Subordinate/root role derivation.
Tickets owns direct many-to-many links at the master/root boundary and preserves subordinate-origin provenance without creating direct child links.
Tickets owns RFC→Device Reference operational relationships, including standalone RFC and subordinate-specific device context.
Tickets owns note identity/current content and history-bearing edit/remove commands; imports do not own Working Notes.

shared_with.boundary: HLD-05 owns observation/staging/provenance; HLD-04 owns the accepted current ticket projection and protected SOMA-owned fields.
HLD-04 owns RFC evidence/exact hierarchy scope and pending cascade command; HLD-06 owns Task/Objective consequences; HLD-10 owns Communication unlink/orphan consequences.
Operational relationships point to Device Reference; HLD-09 owns optional regularization to Network Element without replacing operational relationship identity.
HLD-03 owns Customer identity/matching semantics, HLD-05 owns source evidence/proposals, HLD-04 owns accepted RFC Customer projection and hierarchy consistency.

does_not_own.capability: WFM/Local Task lifecycle, plan, execution, outcome, Objective membership

authority_rules: RFC hierarchy is relationship-derived; no mutable is_master/master_wfm field creates a second hierarchy authority.
SR direct linkage never targets a subordinate RFC.
RFC→DeviceReference and DeviceReference→NetworkElement are separate relationships with separate ownership.
Ticket relationship mutation never implies ticket lifecycle mutation.
Imported/source fields cannot overwrite SOMA-owned relationships or Working Notes merely because the workbook contains similar text.
